skills/coi-profile.description: Write, edit and validate Coi (Code on Incus) profiles, the config.toml files under ~/.coi/profiles/<name>/ or .coi/profiles/<name>/ that set a sandbox's image, AI tool, resource limits, mounts, network mode and security settings. Use when asked to create or change a coi profile or a coi config.toml.
skills/coi-profile.he: Write, edit and validate Coi (Code on Incus) profiles, the config.toml files under ~/.coi/profiles/<name>/ or .coi/profiles/<name>/ that set a sandbox's image, AI tool, resource limits, mounts, network mode and security settings. השתמש בעת בקשה ליצור או לשנות פרופיל coi או הגדרות coi.toml.
